in_arabic.name: محاسنة

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم محاسنة مشتق من الفعل حَسُنَ، وهو يعني كثرة الحسنات و الجميلات، و يدل على حسن الخلق و الكرم، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة و الكرامة، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع مثل سورة النور آية ٣٢ و سورة الفرقان آية ٢

in_urdu.name: محاسنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام محاسنا عربی زبان کے الفعل حَسُنَ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبیاں اور نیکیاں، یہ نام اچھی کرداری اور کرم کی علامت ہے، اور یہ ان ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو اعلیٰ درجے اور کرامت کے مفاہم کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں، جیسے کہ قرآن کریم میں سورة النور آیت ٣٢ اور سورة الفرقان آیت ٢ میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے

in_hindi.name: महासिना
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम महासिना अरबी भाषा के क्रियापद حَسُنَ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अच्छे गुण और पुण्य, यह नाम अच्छे चरित्र और उदारता का प्रतीक है, और यह उन नामों में से एक है जो उच्च दर्जा और गरिमा की अवधारणाओं को प्रकट करता है, जैसा कि कुरआन में सूरत अन-नूर आयत ३२ और सूरत अल-फुरकान आयत २ में उल्लेख किया गया है

in_english.name: Mahasina
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mahasina is derived from the Arabic root حَسُنَ (H-S-N), which means good, beautiful, or fair. It signifies abundance of good qualities, virtues, and beautiful character. The name Mahasina reflects high moral values and is associated with kindness, generosity, and nobility. In Islamic tradition, names with similar roots are mentioned in the Quran, such as An-Nur (24:32) and Al-Furqan (25:2), highlighting the importance of good character and moral excellence.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mahasina" holds a significant cultural impact in various Islamic communities as it is derived from the Arabic term "al-Mahuwa" which translates to the "radiant moon." The name is admired for its association with the Persian and Islamic poetic and literary tradition. The moon is considered a symbol of guidance, a reminder of Allah's existence, and a source of peace and tranquility in Islamic culture. "Mahasina" embodies the charm and splendor that the moon represents, bringing an air of inspiration and wonder. In various Islamic societies, the name Mahasina may be given to a girl to honor the beauty and grace that the moon bestows upon the world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Mahasina" holds profound symbolism as it reflects the light and blessings of Allah. In Islamic tradition, the moon is considered a sign of Allah's power, mercy, and love for his creation. The "moon that bestows beauty and grace upon its observer" acts as a reminder of Allah's infinite generosity, nurturing and caring for His creation, providing light when darkness surrounds us. Thus, carrying this name spiritually signifies being a vessel of Allah's blessings, channeling His light and grace to those around us, and constantly seeking His divine guidance and beauty in the world around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Graceful, beautiful moon" symbolizes Moon that bestows beauty and grace upon its observer. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mahasina serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of graceful, beautiful moon.
